scripts.devNoSteam: npm run syncNoSteam & npm run launch_debug_nosteam
scripts.devMulti: npm run syncNoSteam & npm run launch_debug_nosteam & npm run launch_debug_nosteam
scripts.devWorkshop: npm run syncWorkshop & npm run launch_debug_workshop
scripts.deployWorkshop: dotenv run -- bash -c 'set -eu; npm run clean && cp -rv ./src/. "$HOME/$BUILD_WORKSHOP_PATH/"'
scripts.deployNoSteam: dotenv run -- bash -c 'set -eu; npm run clean && cp -rv ./src/. "$HOME/$BUILD_NO_STEAM_PATH/"'
scripts.build: npx dotenv run -- npx rimraf ./build &&  mkdir -p ./build && cp -rv ./src/. ./build
scripts.generateWorkshopVDF: dotenv run -- bash -c 'set -eu; bash ./scripts/generateWorkshopVDF.sh workshop.json "workingdir=$DEPLOY_WORKING_DIRECTORY" "changenote=$STEAM_WORKSHOP_CHANGE_NOTE" description="@workshop_description.txt"'
